correctness.rationale: Integer root and facet enumeration gives 24 vertices, 96 original edges and triangular faces, and 24 octahedra. A finite exact checker tests all 15 nonempty patterns of four simple-root pairings and all six outer-node triality transformations, with Euler edge and polygon-side consistency. Independent geometric arguments establish that all normals reduce to those 15 strata and that their sign-incidence data exhaust the section face structure.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Coxeter/Weyl symmetry supplies the 15-to-7 reduction but does not yield the explicit seven face inventories without the separate section-incidence computation. originality.rationale: The seven-class stratification adds six singular slice types to the previously documented generic type; exact incidence comparison distinguishes it from shadow-volume, maximal simplex and four-cube slice results. Egan explicitly owns the generic row, and known cuboctahedron/rhombic dodecahedron are acknowledged. Search cannot rule out all unindexed treatments.
residual_risks: Classical special sections and the generic row are known; a historical compendium may enumerate the other exceptional types under alternate names.
The literature search does not prove absolute novelty; independent priority review is not performed.
